data.name: Jagpati
data.long_meaning: Jagpati is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, which means 'Goddess of the Earth'. In Hindu mythology, Jagpati is believed to be the divine mother who nurtures and protects the earth. She is also known as Bhagavati, the goddess of wealth, fertility, and prosperity. This name signifies strength, stability, and the power of creation.
data.spiritual_meaning: The embodiment of the earth and nurturing mother
data.numerology_meaning: People with the name Jagpati are caring, loving, and nurturing. They are natural healers and have a strong connection to the earth. They value harmony and balance in their lives and strive to create a peaceful environment around them.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jagpati holds great significance in Hindu culture as it represents the worship of the earth and the divine feminine. It is common for Hindu families to name their children after various deities, and Jagpati is one such revered name. The name is often associated with prosperity, good fortune, and the abundance of nature.
data.spiritual_significance: At a spiritual level, the name Jagpati signifies the connection between the individual and the divine mother. It offers a reminder of the interdependence of all living beings, including the earth, and the importance of nurturing and protecting it. This name also symbolizes the power of the divine feminine in Hinduism, which symbolizes creation, sustenance, and destruction. Jagpati is believed to be the caretaker of the universe, and her name imparts a sense of gratitude and reverence for the natural world.

historical_references.reference: Jagpati was an incarnation of God Vishnu and is considered the founder of the Jagannatha Temple at Puri, Odisha, India. He appeared around 1100 AD during the Eastern Ganga Dynasty.
